mapper.sql: id, recipient, subject, body, template_key, status, attempts, send_at, last_error, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_mail_outbox (recipient, subject, body, template_key, status, attempts, send_at, last_error, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{recipient}, #{subject}, #{body}, #{templateKey}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{sendAt}, #{lastError}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select from litemall_mail_outbox where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
